simple.meaning: properly, a luminous body or luminary , i.e. (abstractly) light (as an element); figuratively, brightness , i.e. cheerfulness ; specifically, a chandelier
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to מָאוֹר (H3974) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 19 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.

definitions.short: properly, a luminous body or luminary , i.e. (abstractly) light (as an element); figuratively, brightness , i.e. cheerfulness ; specifically, a chandelier
definitions.full: H3974. maor מָאוֺר noun masculine luminary — absolute Gen 1:16 +; construct מְאוֺר Prov 15:30 +; plural מְאוֺרֹת Gen 1:15 ; מְאֹרֹת 1:14 ; 1:16 ; construct מְאוֺרֵי Ezek 32:8 — light, light-bearer, luminary, lamp , of sun & moon Gen 1:14-15 , 16 (3 t. in verse) (P) Ezek 32:8 ; moon Psa 74:16 ; הַמָּאוֺר מְנֹרַת the lamp-stand of the luminary or light (where ׳הַמּ is sum of seven sacred lamps on golden lamp-stand) Exod 35:14 (twice in verse); 35:28 ; 39:37 ; Num 4:9 , 16 , compare Exod 25:6 ; 27:20 ; 35:8 ; Lev 24:2 (all P); יְשַׂמַּחלֵֿב֑ מְאוֺרעֵֿינַיִם Prov 15:30 the luminary of the eyes (= the eyes as a lamp) gives the light of joy to the heart ; מָּנֶיךָ מְאוֺר Psa 90:8 the luminary of thy face (thy face as a lamp) in the light of which the secrets are exposed.
definitions.rootNote: or מָאֹר ; also (in plural) feminine מְאוֹרָה ; or מְאֹרָה ; from 215 ;
